records.title: The Second LoViF 2026 Challenge on Real-World All-in-One Image Restoration: Methods and Results
records.reason: Image-restoration benchmark and image-restoration methods; the primary abstract contains no LLM inference or serving work.

records.title: Progressive Cramming: Reliable Token Compression and What It Reveals
records.reason: Progressive cramming investigates a sequence-compression mechanism, but the body finds that it behaves as brittle attention steering: generation capability collapses and the paper frames the work as studying compression limits rather than providing a usable compressor. The evidence is relevant to inference-time context compression, but does not establish an actionable serving method.

records.title: Mean-to-Score Discrete Diffusion: Posterior-Mean Denoisers for Score Entropy
records.reason: M2S is a discrete diffusion language-model parameterization that improves generation quality over evaluated baselines at matched sampling budgets. The body does not establish inference-time efficiency gains, and the principal contribution is a training/objective change; a concrete deployment-efficiency path is not demonstrated.

records.title: Diffusion Language Model for Recommendation
records.reason: Generative recommendation modeling is the task contribution; the abstract gives no LLM-serving or inference-efficiency evaluation.

records.title: DGNA: Dissecting GPU NUMA Architecture through Microbenchmarking and Data Analysis
records.reason: GPU NUMA microbenchmarking is generic GPU-memory characterization, not LLM-specific inference or serving work.
